open.issue: V019 correlation constraints, scoped JDBC ledger verifier and end-to-end atomicity were not run on real PostgreSQL, with restricted roles, RLS or concurrent writers.
open.mitigation: Deploy reviewed, deny-all quarantined schema in a dedicated PostgreSQL test cell; test policies, exact event FKs, retries, rollback and concurrent writers before application grants.

open.issue: Snapshot v1 lacks a revision-one anchor. v2 decoder can parse it but full JDBC verification rejects unanchored legacy data; an authorized, independently reviewed migration/recovery path is absent.
open.mitigation: Design audit-preserving migration with event-source reconciliation; do not forge missing genesis or allow writes to unanchored clinical cases.

open.issue: GET summary/history endpoints passed synthetic loopback tests but are not deployed behind production OIDC/MFA, clinical-proof services, rate limits or native client builds.
open.mitigation: Wire to approved authenticated runtime, enforce RLS in live cell, verify end-to-end clinical access denials, usability and security review.
